en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a monumental statue complex in a square. A tall pedestal supports a standing male figure in a long coat, with additional seated figures around the base. Behind the monument are low, traditional buildings with tiled roofs. The front of the card has red printed captions at the top identifying the location and subject in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank except for printed Hungarian text and layout lines typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
